_readme: Idle (AFK) reward rates: what time away from the game pays, by the player's progress level (the level of the highest cleared map location, CampaignRules.ProgressLevel). A claim credits the real time since the last claim (wall clock, never more than the monotonic clock says passed; clock tampering is clamped silently) up to CapHours; time beyond the cap is not banked. Per idle hour: GoldPerHour gold; XpPerHour XP to each party beast (the bench gets the bench share of it; the level-gap falloff on the beast's level against the progress level and the beast level cap apply); MaterialRollsPerHour rolls of the drop-tables.json cell (Shape, progress level) with every chance x MaterialChanceMultiplier and no pity or first-clear credit; and per claim one look roll from the battle-drop pool at CosmeticChancePer10k / 10000 x hours / CapHours. Tuned with the balance simulator (dotnet run --project Tooling/BalanceSim -c Release -- --mode campaign; see docs/balance/campaign-pacing-report.md, 'Idle rewards') to the ceilings: idle at most ~15% of gold and materials and ~10% of beast XP over a campaign. Tunable starting values, not confirmed balance. Edit here, then in Unity run Beast Craft/Data/Import Idle Rewards. See docs/design/progression-and-saves.md, 'Idle rewards'.
